note: Lions club RV park in the southeast corner of Leduc beside the Leduc Recreation Centre, about 25 km south of Edmonton, with trails to Telford Lake. Treed and open sites. Hickey Pond, a small pond, lies about 25-30 m across open grass from the P-loop's sites nearest it (around P1-P5); the rest of the park is away from water. The park sits directly beneath an Edmonton International Airport flight path, and the operator warns that aircraft noise is a regular part of a stay. 15-amp sites do not support air conditioning. Pickleball court, playgrounds, fenced dog run. --Claude
